'''First Anthology''' is the 10th Star Wars CCG product, published by Decipher in May 1997. It is the first of three anthology boxes. It contains six '''white-bordered preview''' cards from [[Special Edition]] (3 Light Side and 3 Dark Side), including the first appearance of [[Boba Fett]]. CardGuide numbering: 10th product. MSRP $32.00.<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]</ref><ref name="wook">[https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/First_Anthology First Anthology] at Wookieepedia</ref>

The six cards became tournament-legal with this product and were later printed with black borders in Special Edition. The box is an 800-card storage box and also held two Premiere Unlimited starter decks, two [[A New Hope Limited]] packs, two [[Hoth Limited]] packs, one [[Jedi Pack]], and a rules supplement covering A New Hope through Dagobah. Those randomized packs and starters are reprints and are not listed here.<ref name="encyc" />
